headers:
Since the bid quantities are estimated
and a detailed survey was not
performed, how will actual field
quantities be measured and paid if
they are greater or less than the
quantities shown, including
borrow/fill and riprap quantities?

Please refer to the individual bid item descriptions for
the applicable method of measurement and basis of
payment. Certain bid items are designated as Plan
Quantity items and shall not be field measured for
payment. Payment for such items shall be made in
accordance with the plan quantities, and no adjustment
to the Contract Price will be made based on variations
in actual quantities, field conditions, or construction
methods.
Earthwork, including borrow and fill, is a Plan
Quantity item. The quantity shown in the plans shall
constitute the basis of payment. No separate
measurement will be made, and no additional
compensation will be provided for overruns, underruns,
differing site conditions, or any other conditions
encountered during construction, except as specifically
authorized by the Contract Documents. The
Contractor's bid shall include full compensation for all
labor, materials, equipment, incidentals, and risks
necessary to complete the work as specified.
Prior to submitting bid, bidders are encouraged to
perform a site visit, review all available project
information, and conduct such investigations as they
deem necessary to evaluate existing conditions and
prepare their bid accordingly.
sample:
From the site access point to the
project work area, what type of
surface should the contractor expect?
Please also clarify what areas the
contractor would be responsible for
restoring if damaged during access or
construction so we can account for
that work in our bid.

The access route shown on the Plans consists of an
asphalt drive and an existing unpaved maintenance
roadway that has been regularly utilized by
maintenance vehicles and is more compacted than the
adjacent ground surfaces.

impacted as a result of the Contractor's operations,
